game_concept: A arcade set in The Kingdom – Royal Stables, the royal stables: the royal scribe must handle goblin raiders while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Swap Switch: Swap two variables with a temporary slot to reroute grain sacks without losing either value.
theme: The Kingdom – Royal Stables: the royal stables
core_gameplay_loop: In Royal Stables, repeat each round: Swap two variables with a temporary slot to reroute grain sacks without losing either value. Each round, a new grain sacks challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the a value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 220 points of grain sacks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 220, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 4 (applied tier): Swap Switch
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Swap Switch' (Week 1 slot 4), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Royal Stables'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
